label: Platform adapter register for the agency fleet. Each adapter names installed skills by mount; supported ranges come from the upstream's own compatibility statement at the pinned revision, and a range the upstream does not state is recorded as null.

platforms.name: WordPress sites, plugins, themes and blocks

legacy.route: Below WordPress 7.0 or PHP 7.4.0: run wp-project-triage for detection only and have a human CMS specialist confirm which APIs exist before applying guidance that assumes 7.0.

platforms.standards: WordPress Coding Standards through the project's PHPCS ruleset, and PHPDoc per the WordPress PHP documentation standards; code-standards-checker runs the project's own commands.

platforms.name: WooCommerce stores and extensions

supported.source: Automattic/claude-woocommerce-toolkit at d70538707247 (GPL-2.0) names feature versions but no support range

platforms.standards: WordPress Coding Standards plus the WooCommerce extension guidelines the toolkit cites.

host.note: WooCommerce runs on WordPress, so the WordPress minimums (7.0, PHP 7.4.0) and legacy route apply first

platforms.name: Drupal sites and modules

supported.source: kanopi/cms-cultivator at ff328fcc77af (GPL-2.0) states no Drupal support range

platforms.standards: Drupal Coding Standards through the project's PHPCS ruleset.

platforms.name: Cloudflare Workers applications

supported.source: cloudflare/skills at ff191de7d903 (Apache-2.0); Workers pin behavior by compatibility date, not version

platforms.standards: The project's own wrangler configuration and compatibility date.

platforms.name: JavaScript and TypeScript web applications

supported.source: pstack typescript-best-practices, installed from cursor/plugins per skill-sync sources.json; states no runtime range

platforms.standards: The project's own ESLint, Prettier and tsconfig settings.

platforms.name: Headless CMS (Contentful, Sanity, Strapi and similar)
platforms.blocked_reason: No installed skill covers a headless CMS content model or delivery API; a human CMS specialist owns this platform until an adapter is adopted or written.

platforms.name: PHP frameworks (Laravel, Symfony)
platforms.blocked_reason: No installed Laravel or Symfony skill; code-standards-checker can still run a project's own PHPCS or PHPStan commands, but framework guidance needs a human specialist.

platforms.name: Commerce platforms other than WooCommerce (Shopify, Adobe Commerce, Drupal Commerce)
platforms.blocked_reason: No installed skill for these platforms; woocommerce skills do not transfer.

platforms.name: API-driven services and integrations
platforms.blocked_reason: No installed skill tests API contracts (OpenAPI or GraphQL schemas); wp-rest-api covers WordPress REST only.

platforms.name: Native iOS apps built with SwiftUI

supported.source: gstack ios-* skills installed in the rig (not tracked in skill-sync sources.json); no iOS version range stated

platforms.standards: The project's own Xcode build settings and SwiftLint configuration, if any.

platforms.name: Progressive web apps and Android apps
platforms.blocked_reason: No installed PWA or Android skill; a human mobile specialist owns this platform until an adapter is adopted or written.
